item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02825","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final value 200 after correct formulas; the value increase should be $600.","case2_error":"Evaluates 200 − 60 − 56 as 184 instead of 84, propagating the error to the total.","reason":"Case 1 supplies an unsupported number without showing its calculation; case 2 explicitly evaluates a correctly written expression incorrectly.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02826","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final cost $475 after correct formulas; the total should be $752.","case2_error":"Evaluates 2,250,000 × $0.02 as $450,000 instead of $45,000.","reason":"An unsupported final number differs from an explicit numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02827","case1_error":"Treats four bags as four peanuts, ignoring the 30 peanuts in each bag.","case2_error":"Counts the new batch as 48 brownies, including the original batch again, then adds the 12 remaining brownies.","reason":"Case 1 confuses containers with their contents; case 2 double-counts the original batch when adding the new batch.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02828","case1_error":"Applies the car payment's 20% rate to gross income instead of after-tax income.","case2_error":"Reports only outbound gas costs, omitting tolls and all return-trip costs; the requested weekly total is $118.","reason":"Case 1 uses the wrong percentage base; case 2 omits required cost components and return journeys.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02829","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final count 19 after describing the appropriate counting steps; the correct count is 17.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final count 680 after writing the correct total formula; the correct count is 1,220.","reason":"Both provide incorrect final numbers after correct counting procedures without showing a faulty numerical calculation.","judgment":"same"}]}
